nodes.label: Czech Player Component Translations
nodes.rationale: Player-surface strings: empty states (noRecordingsFoundForThisTime, noPreviewFound, streamOffline, cameraDisabled), an iOS version gate, Frigate+ submission, and a stats.* family (streamType, bandwidth, latency, totalFrames, droppedFrames, decodedFrames, droppedFrameRate) that names the live stream telemetry fields.
